payload.summary: Addressed 16 findings (6 high, 7 medium, 3 low) against the verbatim Phase 3 carry-forward. Added design.md (F1-F7), three spec scenarios (cleanup gate, absent ledger, standalone range), a shared read-only reader task (3.0) and a hook content-test task (3.7), a scenario key table, Files scope on every task, and split 3.6 into a deterministic pytest end-to-end. openspec validate --strict passes; no findings at or above medium remain.
completed_work: [high] consistency: scenario key table resolving skill-workflow.1-11
[high] completeness: cleanup-gate scenario added; task 3.3 no longer orphaned
[high] assumptions: ledger commit policy (F2); Step 11.5 mechanics and failure semantics (F3/F6)
[medium] assumptions: report-row form keeps gate_logic untouched (F4)
[medium] completeness: design.md created; absent-ledger and standalone-range scenarios added
[medium] parallelizability: task 3.0 reader; Files scope on every task
[medium] testability: 3.6 split into pytest e2e + 3.7 hook content tests
[medium] feasibility: skill gate set and runtime resync in checkpoints; 3.5 regenerates docs/decisions
[low] scope/security/clarity: non-goals, untrusted-text risk, failure definitions in design.md

decisions.title: Hook placement pinned to named steps (F1)
decisions.rationale: iterate-on-implementation 11.5, validate-feature Step 11 report row + After Validation, cleanup-feature new 5.5 before archive; the carried text named no step and each skill had several plausible decision points.

decisions.title: Step 11.5 commits the ledger pair when changed (F2)
decisions.rationale: The loop's last commit is Step 10; an uncommitted ledger never reaches the branch-reading gates or the archive move. No-diff re-audit commits nothing; never amend.

decisions.title: Single shared reader needs_user.py in audit-choices (F3)
decisions.rationale: Both gates need the same filter+ranking; two SKILL.md snippets would drift and cannot be unit-tested. Reader opens no file for writing, preserving the skill's read-only invariant.

decisions.title: Choices are a Phase Results row, never a ## Choices section (F4)
decisions.rationale: gate_logic.py parses ## sections with a **Status** line; the row form keeps approve/reject semantics unchanged by construction.

decisions.title: 3.6 fixture is a synthetic repo seeded from the archive (F5)
decisions.rationale: run_audit.py resolves change_dir as openspec/changes/<id>/ with no archive lookup; auditing the archived id in the real repo would create a phantom active change.

decisions.title: Scenario ordinals retained and keyed (F7)
decisions.rationale: Keeps the parent's dependency graph readable; the key table resolves 1-6 to canonical and 7-11 to this delta.

decisions.title: Skipped this skill's vendor-review step
decisions.rationale: The orchestrator owns a separate PLAN_REVIEW phase (cli_review_enabled=true); dispatching here would run the multi-vendor review twice.
